data.name: Rakesh Ghonmode
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Rakesh Ghonmode has made a big mark in cricket. With 19 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 71*, with an average of 29.62 and a quick strike rate of 194.44. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 37 sixes and 21 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 37.2 overs, taking 19 wickets at an economy rate of 9.29. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
